held.title: Broken nested tag now adds a `""` member to the nested type, which may be required at every use site
held.body: With this guard, the tag whose type fails to parse stays in the nested `Args` literal as a property with an empty name. The new baseline shows `keyof Sig["Args"]` as `"" | "name" | "onCancel"`. That property has no brackets and no trailing `=`, so it is probably a required property of unresolved type. If it is, any object or component invocation checked against `Sig["Args"]` (e.g. `const a: Sig["Args"] = { name: "x" }`) now fails with "Property '' is missing". Before the fix, the `""` member went to the top-level `Sig`, which is often never built directly (as in the Glimmer-style signatures in the issue). So the use-site error the issue complains about, reported far from the `TS1005`, could come back in a new form instead of going away. The issue asks that only `Args.onSave` be affected. I could not check from the shown code whether the reparser makes a missing-name property optional. Please add a case like `const a: Sig["Args"] = { name: "x" }` to the test. If it errors, either skip tags with a missing name when building the nested literal, or make them optional.
